title: Fourier coefficient of a function
statement: For a finite additive commutative group $G$, a function $f:G\to\mathbb{C}$, and a complex-valued additive character $\chi$ on $G$, define the Fourier coefficient of $f$ at $\chi$ to be the uniform complex inner product of $\chi$ with $f$.
